# sim2real-score

Robustness scoring for simulation-trained control policies. The tool takes a
trained policy (stable-baselines3, TorchScript, or ONNX) and a MuJoCo
environment, sweeps the physics it was trained under — friction, mass, damping,
actuator gain, observation noise, action latency, sensor dropout — bisects each
failure boundary, and ranks parameters by Sobol total-order index. It outputs a
single robustness score, per-parameter breaking points, an interaction matrix, a
self-contained HTML report, and a suggested domain-randomization config.

This site hosts two example reports generated by the tool itself:

- [Landing page](https://sim2real-score-report.vercel.app/): both runs summarized
- [Hopper-v5 report](https://sim2real-score-report.vercel.app/report_hopper.html): nominal-trained PPO policy, score 21.4/100
- [linear report](https://sim2real-score-report.vercel.app/report.html): built-in linear env, score 87.5/100
